name: vllm-ixuca on Iluvatar CoreX GPU
description: AccelMark runner for Iluvatar CoreX GPUs via the IXUCA software stack (torch_ixuca). Presents the accelerator as CUDA-compatible; no device flag. BF16/FP16; FP8 unsupported. GPTQ/INT8; ixCCL tensor parallelism.
notes: Not yet smoke-tested. Obtain the IXUCA SDK from Iluvatar (proprietary); requirements.txt adds benchmark deps only.
